purpose: Non-destructive Topics sidebar ranking, compact navigation labels, and additive keyword aliases. Does not change answers, original priority, or top quick access lists.

sectionTierMeaning.P1: Higher relevance within this section for Bristol HM
sectionTierMeaning.P2: Secondary or useful follow-up within this section
sectionTierMeaning.REF: Reference/cheat sheet, not phrased as an interview question

rules.scenariosCaveat: P1 within Live Product Scenarios ranks rehearsal importance, not probability that the exact case will be asked.
rules.display: Show P1 then P2 then REF within each existing Topics category, with shortLabel as clickable name; display full original question on open and on hover if useful.
rules.search: Search should match fullQuestion, shortLabel, existing aliases, searchAliasesAdd, answer content, and follow-ups. Deduplicate by questionId; give exact shortLabel/alias matches higher relevance.
rules.preserve: Do not overwrite curatedKey, title, answer, followUps, evidenceStatus, canonicalAnswerId, opentableRecordId, priority, suggestedPinned, Categories, Experiences, Experience Maps, Battlecard, Most Likely or Next Most Likely.
